name: No.1 No One Can Interfere with Love with the Host
original_name: No. 1 Host to no Koi wa Dare mo Jama Dekinai: Daifugo Ichizoku kara Oidasareta Boku no Kareinaru Ten
overview:
After being cast out from a wealthy tycoon family, the youngest son, Sora, wanders the streets when, all of a sudden, the No. 1 host Sho appears before him and forcefully scouts him, saying, “Become a host!”

Resolving to live by his own strength, Sora vows to become the No. 1 host. Sho, in turn, finds himself drawn to Sora. The two overcome interference from family members, senior hosts, and former lovers. This is a pure love, rise-to-the-top romance about discovering true love beyond the abandonment of money and status.
